title: The Door That Stuck on the Mat
youtube_title: The Door That Stuck on the Mat | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small useful favor can be louder than a big speech.
summary: At a market lane of baskets, jars, and flower pots, a door that stuck on a curled mat is awkward for one person. Femi notices Grandma Nia struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
